name: Silver Palace
storyline: Silver Palace is an upcoming Action RPG Set in Stunning Victorian-Themed Metropolis.
summary: Silver Palace is an upcoming open‑world detective action‑adventure RPG developed by Silver Studio and published by Elementa worldwide. It is set in the sprawling Victorian‑style metropolis of Sylvanea, built upon the revolutionary element known as Silver Liquid that has fueled its industrial and social transformation. Players assume the role of a detective tasked with unraveling complex criminal conspiracies and uncovering hidden truths scattered throughout the city. The game seamlessly blends open‑world exploration with dynamic real‑time combat, featuring character switching, skill combos, and QTE‑style finishers. Traversal options include horseback riding, aerial wire‑grappling, and free‑running across richly detailed environments. Silver Palace is built on Unreal Engine 5, delivering high‑fidelity anime‑inspired visuals and cinematic battle sequences. It will be available on PC, major consoles, iOS, and Android devices with pre‑registration now open for global audiences. The title adopts a free‑to‑play model enhanced by gacha mechanics for character and gear progression. An 11‑minute gameplay showcase has been released, offering a deep dive into the game’s mechanics and world‑building. No firm release date has been announced, but further details and developer updates will be shared via the official website and social channels.
